name: The Westin Michigan Avenue
insider_take: This iconic tower puts you in the heart of the Magnificent Mile, where Chicago's pulse beats strongest and the city's architectural legends unfold right outside your window.
whats_special: The Westin Michigan Avenue stands as Chicago's tallest all-hotel building, offering unparalleled views of Lake Michigan and the city's famous skyline. Located directly across from the historic Water Tower, one of the few structures to survive the Great Chicago Fire of 1871, you're positioned at the epicenter of luxury shopping and dining on the Magnificent Mile.
pro_tip: Book a Lake Michigan-facing room on floors 45+ for breathtaking sunrise views and stunning vistas of Navy Pier's fireworks during summer evenings.
dont_miss: Step outside to explore the nearby Chicago Riverwalk and catch an architecture boat tour – you're just blocks away from the departure point. The hotel's prime location puts you within walking distance of Millennium Park, the Art Institute of Chicago, and the start of the famous Chicago Architecture Foundation walking tours.
pros: Prime Michigan Avenue location in the heart of Chicago's Magnificent Mile
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds and premium wellness amenities
Modern fitness center and spa services for relaxation
Easy access to top shopping, dining, and cultural attractions
cons: Premium pricing reflects downtown Chicago location
Busy urban setting with typical city noise levels
